issue.body:
## Problem

`sample-kit open` lists archived projects alongside active ones.

## Fix

`collectOpen(projects)` returns only the projects whose `archived` is `false`.

## Done when

- [ ] Archived projects are left out of `collectOpen`'s result.
- [ ] A test with a mix of archived and active projects checks the result.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): leave archived projects out of open
pr.body: Filters collectOpen on the archived flag and adds a test with a mix of projects.
